subject: Critical Thinking
title: Carl Sagan: Science as a Candle in the Dark
description: One-minute skill: Carl Sagan: Science as a Candle in the Dark.

hook.text: Carl Sagan: a surprising example shows why better reasoning matters.

buildup.text: Carl Sagan sets up the core claim, the assumptions, and the stakes.

discovery.text: Carl Sagan reveals the mechanism or argument that changes the picture.

twist.text: Sagan argued that science isn't just facts – it's a way of thinking.

climax.text: Carl Sagan matters because clearer reasoning leads to better judgments.

punchline.text: Science isn't a body of knowledge. It's a way of not fooling yourself.

quiz.question: What is Sagan's 'baloney detection kit'?
options: A set of critical thinking tools for evaluating claims: testability, evidence, falsifiability
